name: v0.6.30
body:
Release Notes

Fix for MacOS loading charting library properly.

Fix search bar functionality in the documentation feature.

Fix for same-t fund update dialog.

Added simplified Trollbox view to footer of DEX limit order page, Instant Trade page and the Simple Asset Swap page.

Created tip dialog for Trollbox messages and Forum posts/replies.

Show balances within asset selector when choosing from balance assets.

Add sort and filter options to credit offers list page.

Add sort and filter options to list of smartcoins page.

Add sort to call order columns.

Add hide/unhide global settled assets on 'borrowable smartcoins' and 'bid on smartcoin settlement' pages.

Add actions to favourite items.

Add user and issuer actions on asset balance page.

UX improvements for the credit borrow page, open orders page, create vesting balance page, issued asset page, credit deal repayment dialog, 

Temporarily hide the blind transfer page until we've resolved the issues blocking its full implementation.

Fixes to market order calculations, labelling and tooltips.

Make sure we use the one asset selection dialog component.

Reordered items on homepage and in navbar.

Code optimizations & dead code removal.

Improved performance of 'issue collateralized debt' smartcoin list page.

Theme improvements for most pages and dialogs.

Package dependency version updates
